strategy.thesis: Solo-GP micro-fund built on 'early-stage investing × minimal fund size'. Invests in 'solid ventures' (ソリッドベンチャー) — profitable-from-inception, mostly B2B, asset-light businesses run by founders under 30 — and is designed so that even small M&A / secondary exits below ¥1B recover cost.

application.how_to_apply: Contact via website / founder's X account

summary.en: Solo-GP micro-VC founded in 2023 by Takumi Okoshi (ex-Skyland Ventures). Runs a deliberately tiny fund focused on profitable 'solid ventures', writing ¥5M–¥30M checks into mostly-B2B seed companies led by founders under 30, with a thesis that embraces small M&A / secondary exits rather than unicorn outcomes.
